metadata.title: [Kernel][SM70] Extend E4M3 grouped attention to the served context window
metadata.body:
## Purpose

Extend the usable context range of the **existing SM70 E4M3 grouped long-context and compact scalar-tail attention routes**, and add numerical, graph and full-engine validation of that extension.

These optimizations already exist on main. Their long-route qualification is fixed at 262,144 tokens, with a fixed scalar workspace and additional native page-table checks. A Yarn-expanded service window such as `--max-model-len 1048576` produces a wider block table, even for a short current request. The existing optimization cannot safely cover that service window; its admission/workspace checks can reject it during graph warmup.

This PR derives provider capacity, scalar partitions and the existing graph contract from `max_model_len`. It reuses `sm70_grouped_long_fwd` and `sm70_scalar_attention_fwd`, preserves the grouped kernel's 80 splits, and makes the scalar launch and reduction support the planned partition count. Native revision queries keep older or mixed binaries within their known capabilities. The change adds no model-specific runner logic or context-bucket scheduler.

**What the speed comparison means:** both arms use the same built wheel and the same 1M service window. The reference uses the ordinary FP32-partial decode path with `VLLM_SM70_E4M3_LONG_ATTENTION=0`; the optimized arm enables the existing grouped/scalar long route with `1`, using the expanded context contract provided by this PR. The gains show the benefit of making the existing optimization usable in this configuration. They are route-toggle measurements, rather than measurements of two separate main/PR builds or a newly introduced attention algorithm. Even a 32K input in these tables runs in a 1M-window engine; these figures do not claim an additional speedup for a short-window engine that already uses the grouped route.

### Files changed

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `csrc/attention/sm70_grouped_long/kernel/grouped-attention.cu` | Replace the E4M3 table-capacity ceiling with a structural integer bound; expose the dynamic-context ABI revision. Retain the existing grouped computation. |
| `csrc/attention/sm70_grouped_long/kernel/scalar-attention.cu` | Validate runtime workspace coverage; move partition indexing to `grid.x`; tile the FP32 reduction with fixed shared memory; expose the scalar-workspace ABI revision. |
| `vllm/v1/attention/ops/sm70_grouped_long.py` | Resolve the served window and independent native capabilities in the existing family owner; provide one context contract for admission and graph capture. |
| `vllm/v1/attention/ops/sm70_grouped_scalar.py` | Allocate and cache scalar workspace for `ceil(max_model_len / 1024)` partitions; decline incompatible mixed binaries. |
| `vllm/v1/attention/ops/sm70_grouped.py` | Permit wider E4M3 tables only for qualified graph descriptors and a compatible native ABI; retain ordinary-provider and FP16 bounds. |
| `tests/v1/attention/test_sm70_e4m3_dynamic_context.py` | CPU coverage of capacity resolution, ABI combinations, page rounding, invalid bounds, workspace isolation and fallback. |
| `tests/kernels/attention/test_sm70_e4m3_dynamic_context.py` | GPU numerical, live-graph, long-suffix, boundary and large-partition-grid regressions. |
| `tests/v1/attention/fixtures/sm70_grouped_legacy.json` | Refresh family source fingerprints; preserve the frozen legacy admission predicate bodies. Five baseline function fingerprints were already stale. |
| `vllm/v1/attention/ops/sm70_grouped.README.md` | Document the expanded qualified E4M3 boundary and native compatibility behavior. |
| `docs/design/sm70_e4m3_dynamic_context.md` | Explain capacity ownership, native launch/workspace contracts, graph behavior and validation scope. |

Production changes are confined to the first five files.

## Test Plan

Focused reproduction commands, with the matching CUDA extension built:

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/v1/attention/test_sm70_e4m3_dynamic_context.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/kernels/attention/test_sm70_e4m3_dynamic_context.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/kernels/attention/test_sm70_e4m3_scalar_fp32.py tests/kernels/attention/test_sm70_grouped_e4m3_fp32.py
```

Also run the affected family/codec/admission tests, compile-cache cases in separate processes, scoped pre-commit checks and manual mypy. Rebuild the wheel through the CI build flow and rerun the new GPU suite against the installed package outside the source tree.

Full engine: cold single requests at 32K/128K/256K/512K, followed by independent prefix preparation and concurrent decode. Each measured request must generate exactly 1024 tokens. Report only fully resident concurrent cases, checking prefix hits, prefill recomputation, preemptions and a shared decode interval.

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Existing grouped long route | FP16 Q, E4M3 KV | SM70, D256/GQA6, qualified descriptor, q2–q8; request-major q8 batches | Existing grouped provider covers the served window when the dynamic ABI is present | CPU admission tests; GPU FP64 comparisons through 2M; TP4 engine route/replay logs | Full-engine requests beyond 512K; other models, TP sizes and GPUs |
| Existing compact scalar tail | FP16 Q, E4M3 KV | q1, compatible grouped/scalar ABIs, sufficient page-rounded workspace | Reuse workspace planned before capture; live graph replay handles changing lengths | GPU FP64, suffix, page/partition boundaries, zero-length and restored-input tests | Full-engine requests beyond 512K |
| Older/mixed binaries and ordinary providers | Existing formats | Missing revision, insufficient scalar capability, unsupported descriptor or explicit route disable | Preserve conservative capacity and ordinary fallback | CPU ABI/fallback tests and existing family regressions | Older binary builds were not separately rebuilt for GPU execution |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract

- **Enablement:** extends the existing default-enabled route where its shape, codec, native ABI and graph conditions hold. No new switch is required.
- **Benchmark entry:** OpenAI API server; Qwen3.8-27B QUASAR NVFP4 target, `incoai--Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-Yarn4x` draft; DFlash block 8 means seven draft tokens plus one target token. Four V100-SXM2-32GB GPUs, TP4, FP16 model dtype, Yarn factor 4, `max_model_len=1048576`, block size 2048, `max_num_batched_tokens=4096`, `max_num_seqs=8`, utilization 0.83, prefix caching and the reference 128 GiB CPU-offload connector configuration.
- **KV dtype:** target `fp8_e4m3`; draft uses the reference `auto` setting.
- **Build provenance:** wheel source `7c12808790eb53418cff090b97824663a34b651d`, based on main `c98a8d66482333eb8d8b87be72e8856445ac99ec`. The five production files are byte-identical in the submitted commit. Wheel SHA256: `1d3788259716577c87adc46b5a48a6ae464cf8a78b5e39d00e31e6a537ba0398`.
- **Package loading:** installed wheel, system Python; no source overlays, `PYTHONPATH` override or external native library. Both arms use the same build.
- **Route and output evidence:** startup/replay logs identify the 1M bound, q1–q8 and batch capacity 8. All reported requests produced 1024 tokens; output comparison and numerical coverage are described below.
- **Registry and fallback:** reuse the existing FA2 operators and grouped-family admission. Capacity grows only with a compatible native revision and graph descriptor; FP16 and ordinary-provider boundaries remain in place.
- **Configuration and metadata:** reuse per-engine `max_model_len`; existing enable/disable and manifest controls retain their meanings. No new registered variable, unregistered environment read or model-name restriction. Environment metadata, generated architecture reference and parameter-ownership checks pass.
- **Route snapshot:** existing family fixture/frozen-admission regressions; source fingerprints updated, original legacy predicate bodies preserved.

## Test Result

- CPU family/admission/configuration regressions: **240 passed**, including four compile-cache cases run in separate processes. Six existing runner-fixture failures were reproduced on unchanged main and excluded from this total. The new capacity-planning file was rerun during PR preparation: **74 passed**.
- Source-build GPU regressions: **204 passed**, including **58 new dynamic-context cases**. Coverage includes 2M FP64 references and a 65537-partition launch with short live KV, in addition to graph replay and boundary cases.
- Full CI wheel build, `pip check`, imports and server entrypoint checks passed. The installed package passed the new **58 GPU cases** again.
- Scoped formatting, lint, type and ownership checks passed. The layering check reports two unchanged MoE files with the same failures on main; this PR changes neither file nor the ratchet.

### Full-engine output speed

Greedy decoding, seed 17, thinking disabled, fixed tokenized technical text, `min_tokens=max_tokens=1024`, `ignore_eos=true`. Each cell is one measurement. The following cold-prefix single-request results include no cross-request prefix reuse. Decode speed is `1023 / server_decode_seconds`, excluding prefill.

| Input context | Ordinary path tok/s | Extended long route tok/s | Speedup |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 32K | 71.53 | 155.56 | 2.17x |
| 128K | 24.92 | 123.43 | 4.95x |
| 256K | 13.90 | 104.93 | 7.55x |
| 512K | 7.67 | 79.09 | 10.31x |

For concurrent decode, prepare each request's prefix with a distinct cache salt and a one-token generation, then submit requests together with a barrier. These measurements describe output after prefix preparation. All reported cases have zero preemptions, sufficient GPU prefix hits and a common decode interval. **Per-request speed** is `N × 1023 / sum(server_decode_seconds)`; aggregate speed is `N × 1023 / (last output time − first output time)` across the batch.

| Context | Concurrency | Ordinary/request tok/s | Long route/request tok/s | Per-request speedup | Ordinary aggregate tok/s | Long route aggregate tok/s |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 32K | 1 | 71.49 | 155.60 | 2.18x | 71.68 | 156.40 |
| 32K | 2 | 39.42 | 105.93 | 2.69x | 76.52 | 202.98 |
| 32K | 4 | 21.48 | 71.83 | 3.34x | 82.21 | 257.52 |
| 32K | 8 | 11.48 | 44.12 | 3.85x | 87.24 | 304.35 |
| 128K | 1 | 24.87 | 122.38 | 4.92x | 24.93 | 123.71 |
| 128K | 2 | 13.44 | 78.25 | 5.82x | 26.20 | 148.32 |
| 128K | 4 | 6.78 | 50.90 | 7.51x | 26.44 | 177.99 |
| 128K | 8 | 3.58 | 28.43 | 7.93x | 27.68 | 193.29 |
| 256K | 1 | 13.92 | 104.67 | 7.52x | 13.95 | 106.45 |
| 256K | 2 | 7.13 | 60.04 | 8.42x | 14.14 | 114.05 |
| 256K | 4 | 3.60 | 35.38 | 9.83x | 13.96 | 122.93 |
| 512K | 1 | 7.67 | 79.03 | 10.31x | 7.69 | 80.84 |
| 512K | 2 | 3.62 | 39.65 | 10.95x | 7.10 | 74.07 |

The reported paired tests contain **34 measured cases / 88 requests**, each with 1024 output tokens. Cold single-request outputs match token-for-token at 32K and 128K; the first differences are token 438 at 256K and token 331 at 512K. Concurrent outputs also differ in some cases. FP64 operator checks establish numerical agreement within test tolerances; these fixed-text speed measurements do not establish model-quality or token-equivalence guarantees. Acceptance-length differences can contribute to full-engine speed differences.

### Scope and review

Open PR searches for `sm70_grouped`, `dynamic context`, and `E4M3 context` found no matching grouped/scalar context-capacity extension. #1417 concerns DeepSeek-V4 compressed-index graph buckets, a separate execution path.

AI assistance (Codex) was used for implementation, validation and this PR.

Nice work! may you share that and also the Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-Yarn4x drafter pls?

> > ccr.ccs.tencentyun.com/1cat-vllm/vllm-openai:1.5.3.dev10_g7c1280879.d20261107.sm70_dynamic.cu128
> > Docker image available for testing.
> 
> Nice work! may you share that and also the Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-Yarn4x drafter pls?

+ Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-Yarn4x is a modification on the `config.json` of incoai/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2:

This enables YARN in the DFlash drafter
``` diff
49c49,51
<     "rope_type": "default"
---
>     "rope_type": "yarn",
>     "factor": 4.0,
>     "original_max_position_embeddings": 262144
```

+ Then start the container with this compose yml:

``` yaml
name: vllm
# docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.vllm.qwen3_8.1m.yml up -d

x-vllm-common-environment: &vllm_common_environment
  VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN: 1
  VLLM_SM70_QUANT_BACKEND: turbomind
  TORCHINDUCTOR_COMPILE_THREADS: 16
  MAX_JOBS: 16
  VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: 3000

x-vllm-common-volumes: &vllm_common_volumes
  - ./models:/models:ro

x-vllm-common-service: &vllm_common_service
  image: ccr.ccs.tencentyun.com/1cat-vllm/vllm-openai:1.5.3.dev10_g7c1280879.d20261107.sm70_dynamic.cu128
  ipc: host
  environment: *vllm_common_environment
  volumes: *vllm_common_volumes
  restart: unless-stopped

services:
  vllm-qwen3_8-27b-nvfp4-dflash:
    <<: *vllm_common_service
    container_name: vllm-qwen3_8-27b-nvfp4-dflash
    ports:
      - "8018:8000"
      
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-sf", "http://localhost:8000/ping"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 300s

    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          devices:
            - driver: nvidia
              device_ids: ['0', '1', '2', '3']
              capabilities: [gpu]

    command: >
      --model /models/QUASAR-QAT--Qwen3.8-27B-QUASAR-NVFP4
      --served-model-name qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-dflash2bs7
      --performance-mode interactivity
      --trust-remote-code
      --dtype half
      --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3
      --mm-encoder-attn-backend TORCH_SDPA
      --mm-processor-kwargs '{"max_pixels": 4194304}'
      --limit-mm-per-prompt '{"image": 8,"video":1}'
      --attention-backend FLASH_ATTN_V100
      --tensor-parallel-size 4
      --max-num-batched-tokens 4096
      --max-num-seqs 8
      --mixed-prefill-step-latency-ms 0
      --block-size 2048
      --mamba-block-size 2048
      --mamba-cache-mode align
      --speculative-config '{"method":"dflash","model":"/models/incoai--Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-Yarn4x","kv_cache_dtype":"auto","attention_backend":"FLASH_ATTN_V100","draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","enforce_eager":false}'
      --gpu-memory-utilization 0.83
      --seed 0
```
